## Guide 3. How to Customize Colors, Fonts and More


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000019747

Welcome to the Design Settings video for Brilliant Directories' Quick Start Setup Guide. This video will guide you through all of the major features and customizable design options within the Design Settings of the Brilliant Directories platform. Design Settings » Design Settings Index First, navigate to Settings >> Design Settings on the back-end and this section is organized under 5 tabs: Color Sets The easiest way to start designing the website would be via the Color Sets tab where the Pre-Made Color Sets can be found: Simply select the preferred Color Set and click Save Changes . General tab To customize this even further, navigate to the General tab where we have a lot of additional options: Font settings can be changed under the Main Website Design dropdown: Themes There is also the option to start with a brand new pre-made theme. More information regarding how to choose a theme for the site can be found in the article down below: » How To Preview & Activate A Theme
